fields.name: folder
fields.label: Books folder
fields.hint: The ePub reader's books folder, when you set one there: its highlights are in Notes inside it (Books/Notes when it is empty).

options.label: Shuffled, every one before any again
Book by book, in reading order

fields.name: interval
fields.label: Seconds per highlight
fields.hint: How long each highlight shows before the next: 3600 is an hour, 86400 a day.

fields.name: look
fields.label: Look
fields.hint: On e-paper, Light is black on white and Dark white on black.

fields.name: typeface
fields.label: Typeface
fields.hint: A frame draws a typeface it has in its fonts folder (on an ESP32, its TF card: Sync fonts), and its own Ubuntu without one.

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Your notes
fields.hint: The note you wrote on a highlight, under it.

fields.name: clippings
fields.label: Kindle clippings
fields.hint: A Kindle's My Clippings.txt (or another reader's), copied onto the frame, to show its highlights too: its path in the assets (on an ESP32, the TF card).

fields.name: fullScreen
fields.label: Full screen
fields.hint: The whole glass for the quote: no bar of the frame's layout around it.

highlights.name: Book highlights
highlights.description: Your highlights from the ePub reader as full-screen quotes, one at a time: the passage as big as the screen takes, the book, its author and chapter, and your note. A new one every hour (or as often as you set), the one you made last first. Tap, swipe, the arrows or the buttons for the next; a long press opens the book at it. Can show a Kindle's My Clippings.txt too.
